title: Calibration-Order Loyalty Allowance in Calibration Goodwill: Training Notes
content:
Under the Workmanship Warranties, a calibration-order loyalty allowance is added into the calibration goodwill sum on a Calibration Workmanship Warranty. The calibration-order loyalty allowance follows the payments the customer made personally on the customer's calibration orders under ADAS Sensor Calibrations less than twenty-four whole calendar months before the goodwill date: two or more payments, the two-payment calibration loyalty allowance of USD 4.00; exactly one payment, the one-payment calibration loyalty allowance of USD 2.00; no payment, no calibration-order loyalty allowance.

## Training questions

Q. Which payments are counted?
A. Payments recorded on the money history of the customer's ADAS Sensor Calibrations orders that the customer made personally. A payment made on the order by any other payer is not counted.

Q. How far back does the count reach?
A. Less than 24 whole calendar months before the date the goodwill is figured. A payment 24 whole months old or older is outside the count.

Q. Does the amount of each payment matter?
A. No. The allowance turns on how many such payments there are.

Q. What does each count give?

| Payments the customer made personally on calibration orders in the window | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | USD 2.00 |
| 2 | USD 4.00 |
| 3 or more | USD 4.00 |

## Hypothetical illustration

A customer paid personally for a Static Camera Calibration 5 months ago and for a Front Radar Calibration 30 months ago; an insurer paid for a third calibration order last year. Only the first payment counts: one payment, USD 2.00.
